d:
Long, wavy pale-coral hair with thick bangs and a voluminous texture. Large, sparkling emerald-green eyes with a playful expression. Apparent age of twenty despite a childlike maturity. Slender, petite build. Wears a white sleeveless dress with gold trim and a pale pink sash. Two large, curved ivory horns protruding from the forehead and a long, thick scaled tail in a pale coral hue.
BODY COLOR: pale peach skin
